_note: Stub pages for upcoming SLOTAB events, editable at /admin → 'Featured Event Pages'. Every field except title/kicker/slug is optional and the page hides whatever is empty — so an event can go live with just a date and fill in as the photo, copy, and signup links arrive. Keep `date` in sync with the matching entry in slotab-events.json; that file is what feeds the calendar, the ticker, and /upcoming.

events.title: Back to School Day
events.venueDetail: Schedules, picture day, school ID cards, ASB stickers, and merch — with SLOTAB staffing a table all day.
events.photoAlt: SLOHS Welcome Day sign — San Luis Obispo High School Welcome Day
body: SLOTAB runs the merch table at Back to School Day — come say hello, sign up for a membership, and grab Tiger gear before the season starts.
We need volunteers to staff the table. Grab a shift below — it's the easiest hour you'll give the Tigers all year.
The school runs staggered arrival times by grade level; check the SLOHS site for the times that apply to your student.

events.kicker: Our Biggest Night of the Year
events.title: Booster Bash
events.venueDetail: This year's theme: The Tiger's Den. Wear your Tiger gear or black and gold.
body: The Booster Bash is SLOTAB's largest fundraiser of the year — an evening of food, drinks, and both silent and live auctions — and it's the night the SLOHS Athletics Hall of Fame inducts its newest class.

Individual tickets are $100 and include admission, dinner, a no-host bar, the silent and live auctions, and drawings. Reserved tables seat 6 ($600) or 8 ($800), with reserved seating and complimentary wine.
There's a cornhole tournament too — $100 per two-person team, and the winning team takes a prize.
Want to help make the night happen? We're looking for silent-auction coordinators, a live auctioneer, and an MC — and we'd love donations of silent and live auction items.
